description: Deterministic train/validation/test partition specification for all seven biomedical benchmarks in GDF-Net (MIDL 2027).

ISIC-2018.modality: Dermoscopy (Skin Lesion Analysis Towards Melanoma Detection, Task 1)
ISIC-2018.leakage_hygiene: Strict separation: validation (N=100) used exclusively for checkpoint selection, soup weights (0.70/0.30), temperature (tau=2.0), and Bi-ALT T_base calibration.

CVC-ClinicDB.modality: Colonoscopy (Colorectal Polyp Frames from 29 Video Sequences)
CVC-ClinicDB.cross_dataset_transfer: Evaluated zero-shot on Kvasir-SEG test set (N=100) without target fine-tuning.

Kvasir-SEG.cross_dataset_transfer: Evaluated zero-shot on CVC-ClinicDB test set (N=61) without target fine-tuning.

DSB-2018.modality: Cellular Microscopy (2018 Data Science Bowl Stage 1 Train)
DSB-2018.split_protocol: Deterministic 80/10/10 sorted-folder-ID shuffle with random.seed(42); instance masks merged via logical union Y = U_k I_k

ISBI-2012-EM.modality: Serial Section Transmission Electron Microscopy (Drosophila Larva VNC)

CHASE-DB1.modality: Retinal Fundus Photography (Child Heart and Health Study in England)

DRIVE.modality: Retinal Fundus Photography (Digital Retinal Images for Vessel Extraction)
